Hi Holly / Sam —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Per our mutual action plan, we want to lock the POC environment handoff items so engineering can begin full ingest tests next week. Quick list of what Redwood needs from MedTech to complete the staging setup: 

- Org & billing contact (email) for Redwood org invite
- IP ranges for allowlist (staging + CI runners) and preferred maintenance windows for peering setup
- Confirmation whether you want VPC peering or private link (we support both; peering preferred for lower latency)
- Any firewall/proxy egress constraints we should test against
- Procurements/PO contact so we can send the DocuSign MAP and SOW

On our side we'll provision:
- Staging API keys (scoped, time-limited) and a sandbox service account for KV caching tests
- A pre-configured VPC peering proposal (CIDR recommendations) and step-by-step peering runbook
- IP allowlist entries and a small verification script you can run from your side to confirm connectivity

Proposed milestone dates (we can adjust):
- 2026-09-08: MedTech provides org invite + IP ranges + procurement contact
- 2026-09-10: Redwood creates staging keys & shares instructions; networking team schedules peering window
- 2026-09-14: End-to-end connectivity test; initial inference smoke tests

If that timeline works, please reply with the org invite email and IP blocks. I'll drop the DocuSign link to the MAP once we confirm the procurement contact.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop

Thanks Lauren / Holly — quick technical notes from our side to make the handoff smooth: 

1) Org invite + roles: When you invite infra-admin@medtech.ai, please select "Org Admin" for the initial setup so they can accept service account permissions. We'll immediately downgrade to the scoped staging role after verification.

2) API keys & service account: We'll generate two keys — one "staging-read" (rate-limited) and one "staging-rw" for ingestion. Keys will be time-limited (90 days) and token rotation will be documented. We need a single point-of-contact for key delivery verification (ideally someone on your infra team).

3) VPC peering details: We recommend peering with our staging CIDR 10.40.50.0/24. Please confirm no overlap with your networks. We'll provide a small Terraform snippet and a step-by-step peering checklist. Peering teardown steps will be included in the MAP in case you need to roll back.

4) IP allowlist & verification: Once you allowlist the two staging IPs and the CI runner, we'll run a TCP+TLS health check and post the results to the shared drive link. Please ensure your proxy allows outbound connections to ports 443 and 5222 for our monitoring agent.

5) Testing plan & acceptance criteria: Our acceptance test will include a 50-query smoke test (latency <200ms P95) and model output sanity checks using the eval prompt set we ran during demo. If the smoke test passes, we consider the POC "connected" and move to scale tests.

I'll prepare the keys and the peering snippet today once we have the org invite. Connor — can you schedule the peering window on the infra calendar (2026-09-10 20:00 PDT) and share the calendar invite?

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
